relations.name: brigit_active_datum_index_v2
relations.view_sql:
SELECT record_id,
    project_id,
    branch_id,
    record_key AS datum_key,
    statement AS datum,
    datum_scope AS scope,
    record_time AS created_at,
    last_referenced_at,
    verification_status,
    datum_verified_at AS verified_at,
    source_evidence AS provenance,
    supersedes_record_id,
    datum_index_tags AS index_tags,
    payload,
    limitations
   FROM brigit_context_events_v3 d
  WHERE record_type = 'DATUM'::text AND (verification_status = 'VERIFIED'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM brigit_context_events_v3 s
          WHERE s.record_type = 'DATUM'::text AND s.verification_status = 'VERIFIED'::text AND s.supersedes_record_id = d.record_id)) OR (verification_status = ANY (ARRAY['VERIFYING'::text, 'UNVERIFIABLE'::text, 'REJECTED'::text])) AND COALESCE(last_referenced_at, record_time) >= (now() - '10 days'::interval));

relations.name: brigit_save_state_heads
relations.view_sql:
WITH all_edges AS (
         SELECT brigit_save_state_events.record_id AS child_record_id,
            brigit_save_state_events.supersedes_record_id AS parent_record_id
           FROM brigit_save_state_events
          WHERE brigit_save_state_events.supersedes_record_id IS NOT NULL
        UNION
         SELECT brigit_save_state_supersession_edges.child_record_id,
            brigit_save_state_supersession_edges.parent_record_id
           FROM brigit_save_state_supersession_edges
        )
 SELECT record_id,
    project_id,
    branch_id,
    record_key,
    record_kind,
    statement,
    lifecycle_status,
    epistemic_status,
    authorship,
    privacy_scope,
    event_time,
    state_time,
    record_time,
    supersedes_record_id,
    payload,
    source_evidence,
    semantic_tags,
    notes
   FROM brigit_save_state_events e
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM all_edges x
          WHERE x.parent_record_id = e.record_id));

    project_id,
    branch_id,
    record_key,
    record_kind,
    statement,
    lifecycle_status,
    epistemic_status,
    authorship,
    privacy_scope,

relations.name: vera_portable_bootstrap_current
relations.view_sql:
SELECT r.request_claim_id,
    r.request_key,
    r.input_digest,
    r.project_template_id,
    b.project_instance_id,
    'DURABLY_BOUND'::text AS current_state,
    b.binding_event_id,
    b.binding_record_time,
    b.source_evidence_digest,
    b.authority_evidence_digest,
    c.confirmation_id,
    c.retrieval_time,
    c.confirmation_record_time
   FROM vera_portable_bootstrap_requests r
     JOIN vera_portable_bootstrap_bindings b USING (request_claim_id)
     JOIN vera_portable_bootstrap_readback_confirmations c ON c.request_claim_id = r.request_claim_id AND c.request_key = r.request_key AND c.input_digest = r.input_digest AND c.project_instance_id = b.project_instance_id AND c.binding_event_id = b.binding_event_id AND c.binding_record_time = b.binding_record_time AND c.authority_evidence_digest = b.authority_evidence_digest AND c.source_evidence_digest = b.source_evidence_digest;

relations.name: vera_save_state_head_status
relations.view_sql:
SELECT project_id,
    branch_id,
    record_key,
    count(*) AS head_count,
    array_agg(record_id ORDER BY state_time DESC, record_time DESC, record_id DESC) AS head_record_ids
   FROM vera_save_state_heads
  GROUP BY project_id, branch_id, record_key;

relations.name: vera_save_state_heads
relations.view_sql:
WITH all_edges AS (
         SELECT vera_save_state_events.record_id AS child_record_id,
            vera_save_state_events.supersedes_record_id AS parent_record_id
           FROM vera_save_state_events
          WHERE vera_save_state_events.supersedes_record_id IS NOT NULL
        UNION
         SELECT vera_save_state_supersession_edges.child_record_id,
            vera_save_state_supersession_edges.parent_record_id
           FROM vera_save_state_supersession_edges
        )
 SELECT record_id,
    project_id,
    branch_id,
    record_key,
    record_kind,
    statement,
    lifecycle_status,
    epistemic_status,
    authorship,
    privacy_scope,
    event_time,
    state_time,
    record_time,
    supersedes_record_id,
    payload,
    source_evidence,
    semantic_tags,
    notes
   FROM vera_save_state_events e
  WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM all_edges x
          WHERE x.parent_record_id = e.record_id));

relations.name: vera_verified_datum_heads_v2
relations.view_sql:
SELECT record_id,
    project_id,
    branch_id,
    record_key AS datum_key,
    statement AS datum,
    datum_scope AS scope,
    record_time AS created_at,
    datum_verified_at AS verified_at,
    source_actor,
    epistemic_status,
    source_evidence AS provenance,
    supersedes_record_id,
    datum_index_tags AS index_tags,
    payload,
    limitations
   FROM vera_context_events_v3 d
  WHERE record_type = 'DATUM'::text AND verification_status = 'VERIFIED'::text AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM vera_context_events_v3 s
          WHERE s.record_type = 'DATUM'::text AND s.verification_status = 'VERIFIED'::text AND s.supersedes_record_id = d.record_id));
